gaps.what: The year of the Memphis gain and of the Middle Egypt gain: Hyksos and Fifteenth Dynasty pages both silent (Middle Egypt now -1650 and Memphis -1650, both confidence 1); the 1559 BC capture of Memphis on the Seventeenth Dynasty page and Khayan's whole-Egypt conquest conflict with the Kamose page and are not drawn

Pages tried for the thin items and silent or undated: Sharuhen (no year for the fall), Viceroy of Kush and Buhen (no year for Ahmose I's Lower Nubia, nor for the end of Egyptian Nubia c. 1070), Mitanni and Amenhotep III (no end date of the Aleppo contest, no loss to Mitanni), Seti I (Kadesh and Amurru taken, 'soon reverted', undated). Bridges kept at confidence 1: Sharuhen -1547, Lower Nubia -1540, contest end -1438, Syria lost -1352, Kush independent -1077

The Egypt-Mitanni border 'near Qatna on the Orontes' (Mitanni page, undated) is stricter than the Aleppo subtraction in the Syrian vassal land; not drawn. Gap-filler for me-04 (mitanni, hittites): open Mitanni, Thutmose IV, Akhenaten, Amarna letters
Thutmose I's Levantine raid to the Euphrates is on no page opened; open Thutmose I, Akhenaten, Twentieth Dynasty of Egypt
Cliopatria shapes -1000 and -900 are reviewed by the 21st and 22nd dossiers, so this dossier carries two no-verdict warnings
Whether Thebes fell to the Hyksos (pages disagree) and the Hyksos-vassal reading are not drawn; the Abydos Dynasty overlap is open
The 17th Dynasty page gives no territory; the Elephantine-to-Cusae limits are Kamose's time only; no Hyksos tribute or Kush alliance on any page
Nubia, the Levant, Shoshenq I and the High Priests of Amun's relation to Tanis are not on the 21st Dynasty page; the vassal tint for Thebes is a reading

How far south Shoshenq I ruled before 837 (event at confidence 1), his Levantine campaign, Osorkon II and the breakup are not on the 22nd Dynasty page; open Shoshenq I, Osorkon II, Takelot II, Twenty-fourth Dynasty of Egypt
Where the Takelot II civil war was fought, the Leontopolis land and when Kashta took Thebes are not on the pages opened; ruler strip omitted (overlapping co-regents)
